title: The Last Veil Anew
author: Vesper Sandoval
blurb: Sable Fairweather, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
